adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` without `sidekiq_options retry: false` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb). That job can indirectly call `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which does `open(url).read` (app/models/topic_embed.rb) and can raise on network errors/404/timeouts. With Sidekiq’s default retry behavior, failures would be retried with backoff, increasing fetch attempts/load during failures or floods. This is an operational/robustness concern grounded in the diff, not a deterministic functional bug.
